features:
CHEWY GRANOLA BARS: Crisp, salty pretzels with real almonds and chewy granola dipped in a rich, chocolate flavored coating

SWEET AND SALTY: These bars provide a perfect balance of savory nuts and pretzels, and sweet granola

PERFECTLY PORTABLE: Easy bars for snack time, or an on the go treat; Perfect for the pantry, lunch box, and hiking trail

QUALITY INGREDIENTS: No artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup

CONTAINS: Twelve regular cardboard boxes of Nature Valley Granola Bars, Sweet and Salty Nut, Chocolate Pretzel, 6 bars, 7.4 oz; Perfect for instant snacking
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Corn Syrup, Sugar, Pretzel Pieces (enriched wheat flour [wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid], malt, salt, soybean oil), Almonds, Palm Kernel Oil, Rice Flour, Fructose, Tapioca Syrup, Vegetable Glycerin, Cocoa, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Soy Lecithin, Corn Starch, Salt, Barley Malt Extract, Baking Soda, Milk, Natural Flavor, Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Retain Freshness.
